import Foundation
import QuosparrCore
// usage: tier <in.json> <out.json>; in = JSON array of {kind:"jwt"|"raw"|"claim", v:string|number}
let args = CommandLine.arguments
let input = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: args[1]))) as! [[String: Any]]
var out: [Any] = []
for item in input {
    let kind = item["kind"] as! String
    switch kind {
    case "payload":
        // v = raw payload JSON text; builds a token with base64url (no padding) of it
        let text = item["v"] as! String
        let b64 = Data(text.utf8).base64EncodedString().replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "-").replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "_").replacingOccurrences(of: "=", with: "")
        let token = "h." + b64 + ".s"
        let c = GrokSubscriptionTier.jwtTierClaim(from: token)
        out.append(["claim": c.map { String($0) } ?? NSNull(), "name": GrokSubscriptionTier.displayName(fromAccessToken: token) ?? NSNull()] as [String: Any])
    case "token":
        let token = item["v"] as! String
        let c = GrokSubscriptionTier.jwtTierClaim(from: token)
        out.append(["claim": c.map { String($0) } ?? NSNull(), "name": GrokSubscriptionTier.displayName(fromAccessToken: token) ?? NSNull()] as [String: Any])
    case "raw":
        let s = item["v"] as? String
        let t = GrokSubscriptionTier.resolve(s)
        let d = GrokSubscriptionTier.displayName(from: s)
        out.append(["tier": t.displayName, "name": d ?? NSNull()] as [String: Any])
    default:
        out.append(NSNull())
    }
}
try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out).write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: args[2]))
